verified_facts.text: Jamaica Inn sits on an eight-acre property with a secluded beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: peaceful, eight-acre retreat. Be enticed by the warm champagne sands of our secluded beach

verified_facts.text: The hotel's crescent-shaped secluded beach is a 700-foot stretch of golden sand.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our crescent-shaped secluded beach is the blissful base for your day

verified_facts.text: The beach is a 700-foot stretch of golden shore.
verified_facts.excerpt: A 700-foot swathe of warm golden shore awaits.

verified_facts.text: Suite 21, the largest suite, sits on a secluded peninsula with its own private grounds, an oceanfront sundeck and a plunge pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our largest suite can be found on a secluded peninsula with its own private grounds, huge oceanfront sundeck and a plunge pool.

verified_facts.text: The one-bedroom cottages each have an elegant living and bar space, an infinity plunge pool, ocean views and private sea access.
verified_facts.excerpt: each with an elegant living and bar space, infinity plunge pool, sweeping ocean views and private sea access

verified_facts.text: The Blue Cottage is a one-bedroom cottage where guests can step directly onto the sand from its veranda.
verified_facts.excerpt: A one-bedroom cottage so close to the beach, you can step directly onto the sand from your vast veranda

verified_facts.text: The Beach Wing suites have antique furniture and fresh flowers inside.
verified_facts.excerpt: Expect gorgeous antique furniture and fresh flowers inside.

verified_facts.text: The Cowdray Suite is a large first-floor suite with a separate dressing room, a large balcony veranda and sunset views of the sea and mountains.
verified_facts.excerpt: An especially large, first-floor suite with a separate dressing room, large balcony veranda and romantic sunset views of the sea and mountains.

verified_facts.text: All stays include resort amenities, continental breakfast, afternoon tea and evening hors d'oeuvres.
verified_facts.excerpt: All stays include complimentary resort amenities, continental breakfast, afternoon tea, and evening hors d

verified_facts.text: The Ocean Spa is an oceanfront spa with a saltwater sea bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our tranquil oceanfront spa harnesses the healing power of nature, with an array of treatments designed to nourish mind, body and soul. Don

verified_facts.text: The spa has a saltwater sea bath.
verified_facts.excerpt: a soak in the blissful saltwater sea bath!

verified_facts.text: Every Saturday at 3pm the hotel offers complimentary croquet tuition with a glass of rose.
verified_facts.excerpt: Every Saturday at 3pm we offer complimentary croquet tuition with a chilled glass of rosé to help you perfect your technique.

verified_facts.text: The Morrow family has run the hotel since 1958.
verified_facts.excerpt: Since 1958, the Morrow family have lovingly run this iconic island hotel.

verified_facts.text: The hotel has had resident black Labradors since the 1970s, and Shadow V has her own cottage on the property.
verified_facts.excerpt: Shadow V is our resident canine and even has her own cottage on property, too.

verified_facts.text: The British colonial-style inn has no TVs or radios.
verified_facts.excerpt: The British colonial-style inn has no TVs or radios but does promise sea views.

verified_facts.text: The cottages have Indonesian-style interiors, private plunge pools and secluded outdoor showers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cottages add Indonesian-style interiors, private plunge pools, and secluded outdoor showers to the mix.

verified_facts.text: The hotel's look features white columns and blue arches.
verified_facts.excerpt: with an easy island glamour done in white columns and blue arches

verified_facts.text: The hotel is a member of the White River Foundation and takes part in a coral restoration programme.
verified_facts.excerpt: As proud members of the White River Foundation, we protect the waters around Jamaica Inn, and are part of a coral restoration programme

verified_facts.text: The Terrace restaurant serves an ever-changing menu of island ingredients with live music each evening.
verified_facts.excerpt: The Terrace comes alive every evening with an everchanging menu showcasing the freshest island ingredients, and live music to set the tone.

verified_facts.text: Teddy's Beach Bar and Grill serves wood-fired pizzas by the pool.
verified_facts.excerpt: pizzas fresh from the wood fire oven with your feet in the sand

verified_facts.text: Jamaica Inn is about an hour and a half from the airports in Montego Bay and Kingston.
verified_facts.excerpt: Jamaica Inn is located approximately an hour and a half from both Donald Sangster International Airport in Montego Bay (MBJ) and Norman Manley International Airport in Kingston (KIN).

verified_facts.text: Ian Fleming International Airport in Ocho Rios is a 15-minute drive away and suits smaller charter or private flights.
verified_facts.excerpt: Ian Fleming International Airport in Ocho Rios (OCJ) is a 15-minute drive to Jamaica Inn and is suitable for smaller charter or private flights.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre is small.
verified_facts.excerpt: our small but well-equipped fitness centre

verified_facts.text: Konoko Falls, with a waterfall trek and botanical gardens, is 10 minutes from the inn.
verified_facts.excerpt: Just 10 minutes from the inn, this lush natural beauty spot has a waterfall trek, botanical gardens and views across Ocho Rios and beyond.

verified_facts.text: Jamaica Inn is in Ocho Rios.
verified_facts.excerpt: Nestled in Ocho Rios
